versions.label: Version 4
versions.status: Draft: Version 4 from Sam's Revise request of 5 November: an Overview tab holds the December 9 call, the four fit bands with their projects named, the statewide table, the paths after the grant, what to confirm and the next steps; a tab per project follows, in order of fit, each holding its Version 3 card unchanged (Request Adopt, the programs each course is required in, who is in the conversation). The tabs follow the ARIA tabs pattern with arrow keys, Home and End; with scripts off every panel shows, so Sierra reads the whole page (33,979 characters against her 34,000). Remediated: contact email links raised to 24px targets in the project tabs; npm run a11y and an axe pass of every tab at 390px and 1440px, light and dark, passed.
